name: Heliostar Metals Ltd.
summary: Heliostar Metals Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in gold and silver exploration and mining activities in the United States and Mexico. Its flagship property is the 100%-owned Ana Paula gold project, which covers an area of 56,334 hectares located in the state of Guerrero, Mexico. The company was formerly known as Redstar Gold Corp. and changed its name to Heliostar Metals Ltd. in October 2020. Heliostar Metals Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
